[/h2][list][*][p]Players can now select Extra Life as an option on all planets if they do not want to play with more than one creature 🦑[/p][/*][*][p]Added the wound module (this replaces the true damage module)[/p][/*][*][p]Private Galaxies now delete default creatures if more than 3 player-made creatures have been added to a depth 🦑[/p][/*][*][p]Credits have been added to the start menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to show extended information during combat[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to make the unspent DNA points warning less strict 🦑[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hotkey section to options[/p][/*][*][p]Best results now turn golden if you managed to reach depth 25 or beyond[/p][/*][*][p]Tasks now turn golden if you finished them 50 times[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Progression Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Increased the research points that you get for reaching research stations to 2, 4, 4, 5 (previously 1, 2, 2, 5)
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The True Damage Module has been replaced by the Wound Module[/p][/*][*][p]Tridacna heals to 25% health when it closes (down from 50%)[/p][/*][*][p]Increase creature health modifier gives +4 health (up from +3)[/p][/*][*][p]Speed scaling has been reduced by around 10% (60 to 55)[/p][/*][*][p]Robot base speed has been increased to 4 (up from 3)[/p][/*][*][p]Strong Core gives +3 health (up from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Charged Core gives +3 health (up from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Wind Up Core gives +2 health (up from 0)[/p][/*][*][p]Venom +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Companion Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Chaotic Energy Core gives +2 health (up from 0)[/p][/*][*][p]Hybrid Core gives +4 health (up from 3)[/p][/*][*][p]Dwarf Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Spiral Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Sensei Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Fast Forward Core gives +3 health (up from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Doom Clock Core gives +5 health (up from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Deadly Core gives +3 health (up from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Bounty Hunter Core gives +3 health (up from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Tinkerer Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Lightning Core gives +2 health (up from 0)[/p][/*][*][p]Mutagen Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Repeater Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Witch Core gives +4 health (up from 0)[/p][/*][*][p]Time Bomb Core gives +5 health (up from 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Remedy Core gives +3 health (up from Have fun playing :)[/p]

notes.title: First Week Lookback + What’s to Come
notes.content: [h1][b]First Week Lookback + What’s to Come[/b][/h1][p]Evolve Lab has now been out in early access for one week. It’s incredible to see that over a thousand of you have already created more than 30,000 creatures.[/p][p]I love seeing the different builds you are coming up with and I am excited to watch the meta take shape in the days ahead.[/p][p]It has also been amazing to see so many content creators cover Evolve Lab. If you haven’t watched them yet, I highly recommend searching for Evolve Lab on YouTube.[/p][p]It makes me really happy to see a small and dedicated community beginning to form :)[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Your feedback matters[/h2][p]I am constantly collecting your feedback and using it to guide the future of the game. If you have been enjoying Evolve Lab, it would mean a lot if you could take a moment to write a review. Reviews not only help me improve the game by showing what you like and what could be better, but they also help new players discover it and grow the community.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]Tentative Roadmap[/h1][p]I have put together a rough roadmap of what will be added and changed. The order and priority may shift depending on your feedback, but my plan is to release a new patch at least every two weeks.[/p][p]Here is what I am working on:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Extra Lives on all planets[/b][/h3][p]Many of you have asked for this, so I will be adding the option to choose one or two extra lives instead of multiple creatures on all current and future planets.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Faster Progression[/b][/h3][p]If players struggle to get a strong run early on, unlocking new content can take longer than intended. I will adjust the research points earned for reaching certain depths to make progression smoother.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Post-Combat Screen[/b][/h3][p]After each battle, you will be able to look at the creature you just fought. In later updates I also plan to add more detailed combat stats to this screen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Skins and Hats[/b][/h3][p]I’m certain many of you have already collected quite a few pioneer tokens. Once this feature is ready, you will be able to use them to unlock skins and hats, which can then be added to your creatures by spending research or deep research points. These will not alter the gameplay in any way and only change how your creature looks.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Rotating Planets[/b][/h3][p]Rotating planets will be time-limited with a small selection of creatures and shop options, and possibly even special rules. They are designed to add more variety to the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Planet 5 and unstable planets[/b][/h3][p]New planets are of course on the way. Each planet will come with 2 new creatures, 10 new actions, 4 new modules, and 12 new cores. Before all content for a planet is finished, I will occasionally release unstable versions where players can test some of the new content. Keep in mind that not everything shown there will necessarily be added permanently, and some elements may change significantly.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Better Depth Overview[/b][/h3][p]I want to redesign the depth overview and expand the information it shows so that you can see how many fights your creature is winning and other stats you might be interested in. I am also considering adding a leaderboard to the depth overview.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Polish[/b][/h3][p]Mechanically the game is already in a good place, but presentation can always be improved. I plan to add new particle effects, sound effects, and enhancements to the UI and existing textures.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Performance and Networking Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The game runs smoothly for most players, but a small group has reported performance or connection issues. I will continue to work on fixes and optimizations to minimize these problems.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Please keep in mind that I am working on this project mostly alone, so it may take some time to implement all of these features.[/p][p]Once again, thank you all so much for playing, sharing your thoughts, and helping shape Evolve Lab into the best game it can be. Having all of you here is what motivates and fulfills me the most while working on the game :D[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Patch 1.0.1 Patchnotes:[/h1]

I just released a small patch, that fixes some bugs and reported issues in the demo. 

General improvements:
[list]
[*]Unlock cost for planets and creatures have been decreased.
[*]The game now more frequently checks, whether a new depth has been reached by another player. This will decrease the chance of a player getting an end reached message even thought an other player already reached that depth during this run.
[*]Username selection now starts with the input in focus and the name already selected
[*]Random team button is disabled, if a player only has one creature type to select from.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug were dash would behave weirdly if it was followed by another dash at exactly the same time when the dash ended.
[*]Fixed a bug where a run would not count as finished, if the player returns to the main menu during the run overview screen.
[/list]

I am also currently reworking the unlock system, as that is confusing a lot of players. Hopefully I can also release that later today.

notes.title: Evolve Lab Demo is available NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]🎉🎉 The demo for Evolve Lab has just been released! 🎉🎉[/h3]

You can download it from the games store page.

[h3]The demo features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 6 unique creatures to pick from
[*] 30 different actions
[*] 11 different modules and modifiers to further modify actions
[*] 30 different cores to make your creatures even more unique
[/list]

Demo progress will carry over to the full release.

I'm looking forward to your feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Evolve Lab Demo Release Date and Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce that the Evolve Lab Demo will officially launch this Friday,[b] May 30st at 20:00 CET! [/b]

This marks a big milestone, and I’m incredibly excited to share this with all of you who’ve supported the project so far. The demo will also be part of Steam Next Fest, which kicks off on June 9th. This gives me one more week to refine the demo and I'm counting on your feedback and suggestions to have a great version ready for everyone who will experience Evolve Lab for the first time during it.

If you’ve checked out the store page recently, you may have noticed the stunning new visuals! Huge thanks to RedPotionStudios for creating the gorgeous promotional art!

[h3]Whats changing with the demo release?[/h3]
[list]
[*]The closed alpha phase will end once the demo goes live. Alpha keys will no longer be valid.
[*]Progress will be fully reset when switching to the demo.
[*]From this point forward, demo progress will carry over to the full release!
[*]You can still expect planets to be reset occasionally to keep the meta fresh.
[/list]

[h3]Future Announcements:[/h3]
Moving forward, most official updates like patch notes and news will be posted here on Steam. On the Discord server, I will keep it more personal and try to interact with you guys as much as possible. My dream would be to create a close community of people that love playing this game. So feel free to join the community, if you haven't already: [url=https://discord.gg/gnCBX6dPtd]Discord server[/url].

[h3]Thank You[/h3]
To everyone who’s played the game, shared feedback, and been part of this journey so far, thank you! Your input has been a huge part of shaping what Evolve Lab has become and I can’t wait to see what you think of the demo and how the game evolves from here on.
